# American Snow & Ice Solutions

> Commercial and industrial snow and ice management company based in Walnutport, Pennsylvania. The company serves eastern Pennsylvania, western New Jersey, southern New York, and northern Delaware.

Canonical website: https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/

## Primary services

- [Commercial snow plowing](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/services/commercial-plowing): Property-specific routing, modern plowing equipment, loaders, containment plows, and roving snow supervision.
- [De-icing and salting](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/services/deicing-salting): Pre-treatment, in-event applications, temperature-aware material selection, and post-event treatment.
- [Sidewalks and walkways](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/services/sidewalks-walkways): Dedicated pedestrian-zone equipment and crews for entrances, ramps, stairs, crossings, and walkways.
- [Weather reporting](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/services/weather-reporting): Forecast intelligence, field documentation, geo-fenced service records, and post-event reporting.
- [Winter risk management](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/services/risk-management): Pre-season assessment, priority-zone planning, communication protocols, and event documentation.

## Company and coverage

- [Company history](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/about): A three-generation family operation with more than four decades of snow experience.
- [Service areas](https://americansnowandicesolutions.com/service-areas): Eastern Pennsylvania and surrounding regional markets.
